run_flask_server: run the flask server on a custom port or default port 3000 for the DCI explorer
extract_data_by_key: extract dataset annotations and convert the associated image to base64 with navigation keys
get_data_by_path: get dataset item data and base64 image for a given entry path via the getdata route
serve_bundle_js: serve the compiled bundle.js file from the view build directory
catch_all_spa_route: serve index.html as a catch-all route for single page application fallback
